legal.aboutIntro: PlayDex is a community platform dedicated to tracking video game patch notes. It is a non-commercial prototype, built as an exam project for the French professional qualification Concepteur Développeur d'Applications (application designer and developer): the site is not operated for any commercial purpose, carries no advertising, and sells no data.
legal.missionText: PlayDex aims to gather game update histories in one place and let the community complete and correct them. Every patch note can be enriched by members, and every change is kept, dated, and attributed to its author so that the history stays verifiable by everyone. Game information comes from public sources, notably IGDB and Steam.
legal.teamText: PlayDex is developed in an educational setting by a candidate for the Concepteur Développeur d'Applications qualification. No company operates the service. The platform evolves with the training project and may experience downtime, resets, or changes in how it works.
legal.contactText: To report inappropriate content, use the reporting feature built into the platform. For any question about the project or about your personal data, write to the contact address listed on the project repository.
legal.privacyIntro: PlayDex is a non-commercial prototype built for an exam. It nonetheless applies the principles of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR): we collect only what the site needs to work, we use no advertising trackers, and we sell no data. Because this is an educational project, we advise against entering sensitive data or a password you use elsewhere.
legal.dataCollectionText: Creating an account records your email address, your username, and your password in hashed form (it is never stored in clear text), along with the account creation date, the last login date, and your email notification preference. Using the site records the games you follow, your contributions (patch notes, modifications, reports) and, where applicable, moderation measures concerning you: warning, suspension, reason, and end date. An authentication cookie keeps you signed in; your browser's local storage keeps your cookie choice, your language, and a temporary draft of your edit forms, automatically cleared after ten minutes. Game data comes from public sources (IGDB, Steam) and contains no personal data.
legal.dataUsageText: Your data is used only to operate the service: managing your account and authentication, publishing and attributing your contributions, notifying you if you opted in, and keeping the community safe and moderated. You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your personal data. Deleting your account makes your profile inaccessible and ends the use of your account data. Your public contributions and the username under which they were published are however retained: PlayDex rests on a collaborative history in which every version must remain attributable and verifiable, which constitutes a legitimate interest in not erasing them. The same applies when an account is suspended.
legal.securityText: Passwords are hashed, API access relies on authentication tokens, sensitive actions are restricted by role, and request rates are limited to prevent abuse. As this site remains an exam prototype, it does not carry the operational guarantees of a production service: do not store anything here whose loss or disclosure would harm you.
legal.privacyMore: To exercise your rights or ask a question about how your data is processed, contact us at the address listed on the project repository. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority (in France, the CNIL).
legal.termsIntro: By using PlayDex, you accept these terms. PlayDex is a non-commercial prototype built as part of an exam for the Concepteur Développeur d'Applications qualification. The service is provided as is, with no guarantee of availability or of content retention: it may be changed, reset, or shut down at any time.
legal.platformUsageText: You agree to use PlayDex in compliance with applicable laws and with respect for other community members. Your account is personal and you are responsible for its use. Any abusive or fraudulent use, as well as any breach of the community guidelines, may lead to a warning, a temporary suspension, or a permanent ban, for which the reason is given to you.
legal.userContentText: You are responsible for the content you publish and you warrant that you hold the rights needed to share it. By publishing on PlayDex, you accept that your contribution is displayed publicly, attributed to your username, and may be edited or extended by other members. Because these contributions form a collaborative history that must stay coherent and verifiable, they are retained after your account is deleted or suspended, along with the username under which they were published. Moderation reserves the right to remove any content that is inappropriate or contrary to the community guidelines.
legal.termsChangeText: These terms may be modified, particularly as the training project progresses. Significant changes will be flagged to you. By continuing to use the platform, you accept the terms in force.
legal.termsMore: For any question regarding these terms, contact us at the address listed on the project repository.
legal.guidelinesIntro: PlayDex rests on collaborative content: anyone can complete or correct a patch note. To keep it useful to everyone, each change is public, dated, and attributed to its author, and the guidelines below apply to every contribution.
legal.respectText: Every member must show respect for others, avoid hateful, discriminatory, or offensive speech, and favor mutual aid. Correcting someone's contribution is part of how the site normally works: do it to improve the information, never to target a person.
legal.forbiddenContentText: Strictly prohibited: violent, illegal, discriminatory, or sexual content, publishing other people's personal data, advertising or off-topic content, and knowingly false information. Vandalism, meaning the deliberate degradation or deletion of valid contributions, is treated as a serious violation.
legal.reportingText: If you come across content or behavior that breaks these guidelines, use the reporting feature. Every report is reviewed by moderation, which may remove the content and apply a graduated sanction: warning, temporary suspension, then permanent ban, always with a stated reason. The modification history makes it possible to trace the author of every change.
legal.guidelinesClosing: Thank you for contributing to a positive and reliable community!
